## Open a generated file

Choose the **file card** under the reply, or a file link in the text. A file that can be previewed opens in the side panel. Several files become several tabs. Choose a tab to switch, and **×** to close the preview.

The same list is shown below as Markdown and CSV:

<ProductFileGuide markdownScreen={previewScreen} csvScreen={csvScreen} />

Two buttons at the top right of the preview are used often:

- **Open with default app**: open the file in an app on this computer.
- **Show in folder**: reveal the file in the system file manager so you can see where it was saved.

After a full-screen view, choose **Exit full screen** at the top right to return to the chat and side panel.

## See results and the original material

Choose the list icon, **Overview**, at the top left of the side panel. The panel lists **Artifacts** first, so you can reopen files the task delivered.

To browse the project’s original material, open the **Overview** menu in that panel, switch to **Workspace files**, and choose a file name.

## Revise the generated file

In the original task, say what to change and whether to overwrite the file or save a new one. For example:

<PromptExample composer={true} prompt="Move the unconfirmed items in “todo-list.md” to the top and turn them into questions that can be sent to the owner. Keep the original to-do list and the source lines. Save the new file as “todo-list-v2.md” and give me the new file link." />

<details>
<summary>A file will not open, or there is no preview</summary>

- If it says the file was moved, deleted, or cannot be accessed, confirm it is still in the same place, then choose **Retry**.
- If the format is unsupported or the file is large, choose **Open with default app**.
- If a generated file still will not open, send the file name and the error in the original task and ask Memmy to check it and generate it again.

</details>

To create a Word, Excel, or PowerPoint file, install the matching plugin from [Plugins](/docs/en/plugins/overview).
